adjudication.rationale: The diff does replace the prior incremental membership API that used `PATCH /admin/groups/:id` with `changes` (see removed `update_patch` and the `request.patch?` branch in `Admin::GroupsController#update`) by introducing new routes `put "members" => "groups#add_members"` and `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` under `resources :groups` in `config/routes.rb`. There is no backward-compatible alias/shim route or controller handling for the old PATCH behavior. This is an externally visible API change that can break out-of-tree clients/plugins, but it’s not an internal correctness defect in the new implementation itself.
